title: A Bug on the Bus
lines: Sam got on a big bus.
A bun is in the bag.
But a bug got in the bag!
The bug bit the bun. Sam did sob.
A man got the bug in a cup.
Sam is not sad. The bug is not bad.
The bug got a bit. Sam got the bun.

questions.listenFor: A bug. It is right in the story. If your child guesses, point at the line with the word bug and read it again.

questions.ask: How did the man help Sam?
questions.listenFor: He caught the bug in a cup. Listen for the cup - that is the turn in the story.

questions.ask: Do you think Sam was kind to share the bun with the bug? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. You are listening for a reason, like the bug was hungry too, or it was Sam's bun first.
